top_offers.title: Head of Software Engineering
top_offers.why: A Head of Engineering seat at a fast-growing, AI-first biotech startup in Switzerland, which lines up well with the founding-team background from Alaya and the eventual Benevity acquisition. It's in Lausanne rather than Geneva and the stack details are thin in the posting, so it's worth a closer read before applying, but the leadership scope and mission fit are both strong.

top_offers.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Platform Engineering
top_offers.why: Solid platform-engineering scope and strong US-remote pay, but it's a Senior title rather than Staff+/founding, and the US timezone is a step down from the Europe-friendly remote preference. Worth a look mainly for the compensation and platform ownership.

top_offers.title: Platform Engineer / Ingénieur Plateforme
top_offers.why: Geneva-based with genuine Python and ML-infrastructure work, including embeddings and vector databases, which plays to the AI-augmented engineering angle. The confidential finance-enterprise employer and generic 'Platform Engineer' title suggest it sits below Staff-level scope, and there's no company name yet to vet culture fit.
